description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for processing assistant text segments, including handling special tags like <think> and <final> to distinguish between different content types such as responses and internal thinking segments.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A struct representing a segment of text with a type (thinking or response) and a unique identifier.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw input text into an array of AssistantTextSegment objects, optionally including or excluding 'thinking' segments based on tags.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the visible (non-thinking) segments from the raw input text.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks whether the raw input contains visible content, considering whether to include thinking segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks whether the raw input contains visible content, excluding thinking segments.

methods.name: nextTag(in:from:)
methods.description: Finds the next tag (<think>, </think>, <final>, </final>) in the input text starting from a given index.

methods.name: findTagStart(tag:closing:in:from:)
methods.description: Locates the start position of a specific tag in the text, accounting for case and boundary conditions.

methods.name: isSelfClosingTag(in:tagEnd:)
methods.description: Determines if a tag is self-closing by inspecting trailing characters before the closing '>'.

methods.name: appendSegment(kind:text:to:)
methods.description: Appends a trimmed segment to the segments array if it contains non-empty text.
